column3: 我怀疑天劫劈下来的那一刻，大家想的都差不多。
column4: I suspect everyone thinks the same thing the moment the tribulation strikes.

column3: 活到这个年纪，我开始怀疑长生到底是不是祝福。
column4: At this age, I'm starting to doubt whether immortality is really a blessing.

column3: 我怀疑自己修炼这么久，换来的只是更长的等待。
column4: I suspect all this cultivation has earned me is just a longer wait.

column3: 每次轮回，我都希望这次能少一点遗憾。
column4: Every reincarnation, I hope for a little less regret this time.

column3: 我怀疑自己拼命变强，只是因为不敢面对变弱。
column4: I suspect I push to get stronger only because I'm afraid of getting weaker.

column3: 死过一次之后，连害怕都变得有点奢侈。
column4: After dying once, even fear starts to feel like a luxury.

column3: 我怀疑修仙界的长生，其实是另一种监禁。
column4: I suspect immortality in the cultivation world is just another kind of imprisonment.

column3: 活得越久，越觉得自己的故事其实没那么重要。
column4: The longer I live, the less important my own story feels.

column3: 我怀疑这一世，我只是想证明自己曾经存在过。
column4: I suspect this life is just me trying to prove I once existed.

column3: 寿元一点点变少的感觉，比突破失败还让人清醒。
column4: Watching my lifespan slowly tick down sobers me up more than any failed breakthrough.

column3: 我怀疑自己拼了这么久，其实只是怕被比下去。
column4: I suspect I've been grinding this hard just out of fear of falling behind.

column3: 活到现在，我开始怀疑意义这个词本身就是个幻觉。
column4: At this point, I'm starting to suspect the word meaning itself is just an illusion.

column3: 我怀疑天道给我的考验，其实没有标准答案。
column4: I suspect the trials heaven gives me don't actually have a correct answer.

column3: 每次死后重生，我都觉得自己好像更懂了一点，又好像什么都没懂。
column4: Every time I'm reborn, I feel like I understand a bit more, and yet nothing at all.

column3: 我怀疑长生不老的代价，是慢慢忘记自己为什么想活着。
column4: I suspect immortality's price is slowly forgetting why you wanted to live.

column3: 活得久了，连孤独都开始变得可以忍受。
column4: After living long enough, even loneliness becomes bearable.

column3: 我怀疑修炼的尽头，不是变强，是变得习惯一个人。
column4: I suspect the end of cultivation isn't strength, it's getting used to being alone.

column3: 寿元耗尽前，我希望自己至少笑过比哭多。
column4: Before my lifespan runs out, I hope I laughed more than I cried.

column3: 我怀疑这一生最大的成就，是没有彻底放弃。
column4: I suspect my greatest achievement this life is simply not giving up entirely.

column3: 活到这个境界，我才明白突破失败也没什么大不了。
column4: At this stage, I finally understand failing a breakthrough isn't such a big deal.

column3: 我怀疑天道考验我，其实是想看我撑到哪一步。
column4: I suspect heaven's trials are just there to see how far I can hold on.

column3: 死过那么多次，我反而更怕活得没意思。
column4: After dying so many times, I'm more afraid of living meaninglessly than of death itself.

column3: 我怀疑修仙这条路，本质上和普通人的人生没差太多。
column4: I suspect this cultivation path isn't all that different from an ordinary person's life.

column3: 活得越久，越觉得当年那些纠结的事，其实都不算事。
column4: The longer I live, the more those things I once agonized over feel like nothing at all.

column3: 我怀疑自己最怕的不是死亡，是被遗忘。
column4: I suspect what I fear most isn't death, it's being forgotten.

column3: 轮回到现在，我开始怀疑活着本身就已经是种修行。
column4: After all these reincarnations, I'm starting to think living itself is already a form of cultivation.

column3: 我怀疑长生的意义，从来不是活得久，是活得值。
column4: I suspect the point of immortality was never about living long, but living well.

column3: 寿元还剩不多的时候，我反而觉得心里踏实了。
column4: With my lifespan running low, I oddly feel more at peace.

column3: 我怀疑自己拼命修炼，到最后图的不过是个安心。
column4: I suspect all this desperate cultivation, in the end, is just for peace of mind.

column3: 活到现在，我开始觉得突破不突破，其实没那么重要了。
column4: At this point, I'm starting to feel like breaking through or not doesn't matter as much.

column3: 我怀疑这世上根本没有真正的圆满，只有学会接受。
column4: I suspect there's no true fulfillment in this world, only learning to accept.

column3: 轮回这么多次，我渐渐明白，活着本身就值得感激。
column4: After this many reincarnations, I've slowly come to feel that simply being alive is worth gratitude.

column3: 我怀疑自己一直追求的强大，其实只是想保护重要的人。
column4: I suspect the strength I've been chasing was always just to protect the people who matter.

column3: 死亡这件事经历多了，反而让我更珍惜清醒的每一刻。
column4: Experiencing death so many times has only made me cherish every waking moment more.

column3: 我怀疑修仙这条路最难的部分，从来不是境界，是坚持。
column4: I suspect the hardest part of this path was never the realm, it was perseverance.

column3: 活得久了，我才明白所谓天道，可能也只是想让人成长。
column4: After living long enough, I've realized heaven's will might just be trying to help us grow.

column3: 我怀疑自己最终想要的，不是飞升，是被人记住。
column4: I suspect what I ultimately want isn't ascension, it's to be remembered.

column3: 轮回那么多次，我开始觉得每一世都有它自己的意义。
column4: After so many reincarnations, I'm starting to feel each life has its own meaning.

column3: 我怀疑自己一直害怕的，不是变老，是没有成长。
column4: I suspect what I've always feared isn't aging, it's failing to grow.

column3: 今天数了数自己的灵石，一共三枚。
column4: Counted my spirit stones today. Three in total.

column3: 今天看到二狗在偷懒，决定跟他一起偷懒。
column4: Saw Ergou slacking off today. Decided to join him.

column3: 村口的老槐树今天落了一片叶子，感觉很有道理。
column4: A leaf fell from the old tree at the village entrance today. Felt very profound.

column3: 今天试着打坐，坐了十分钟就饿了。
column4: Tried meditating today. Got hungry after ten minutes.

column3: 邻居家的鸡今天又跑进了我的院子。
column4: The neighbor's chicken wandered into my yard again today.

column3: 今天悟出一个道理：修仙不如先吃饭。
column4: Realized something profound today: eating comes before cultivating.

column3: 听说隔壁村有人突破了，心里有点不是滋味。
column4: Heard someone from the next village broke through today. Felt a bit sour about it.

column3: 今天把功法书翻了三页，然后睡着了。
column4: Flipped through three pages of the manual today, then fell asleep.

column3: 村长今天又夸我有灵根，但没说是哪种。
column4: The village chief praised my spiritual root again today, without specifying which.

column3: 今天在山下捡到一块奇怪的石头，扔了。
column4: Found a weird rock at the foot of the mountain today. Threw it away.

column3: 练气的时候打了个嗝，感觉灵气都跑了。
column4: Burped while cultivating qi today. Felt like the qi escaped.

column3: 今天想了想，决定先睡个午觉再修炼。
column4: Thought it over today, decided to nap before cultivating.

column3: 听说天才修士三岁就能引气，我十六岁才刚开始。
column4: Heard prodigies can draw qi at age three. I'm sixteen and just starting.

column3: 今天试着冥想，脑子里全是晚饭吃什么。
column4: Tried meditating today. Mind was full of thoughts about dinner.

column3: 村里的狗今天追了我半条街，跑得比我修炼还认真。
column4: The village dog chased me down half the street today. Ran harder than I cultivate.

column3: 今天悟道未成，但学会了一个新的叹气方式。
column4: Failed to gain insight today, but learned a new way to sigh.

column3: 听人说大器晚成，我决定先晚一点。
column4: Heard great talents bloom late. Decided to bloom even later.

column3: 今天的灵气浓度感觉和昨天一样，可能是错觉。
column4: Qi density felt the same as yesterday. Might be an illusion.

column3: 练功的时候邻居在装修，专注力全无。
column4: The neighbors were renovating during training today. Lost all focus.

column3: 今天给自己定了个目标：明天再定目标。
column4: Set a goal for myself today: set a goal tomorrow.

column3: 村口的占卜先生说我今年运气不错，希望他没收钱乱说。
column4: The fortune teller said my luck is good this year. Hope he wasn't just saying that for money.

column3: 今天打坐时差点睡着，灵气没吸到，倒是流了点口水。
column4: Almost fell asleep meditating today. No qi absorbed, but some drool was.

column3: 听说修仙界很卷，我决定先卷被子。
column4: Heard the cultivation world is competitive. Decided to wrap myself in a blanket instead.

column3: 今天对着镜子练习了一下高人的眼神，效果一般。
column4: Practiced my wise-sage stare in the mirror today. Results were mediocre.

column3: 村里来了个游商，卖的丹药看起来很不靠谱。
column4: A traveling merchant came to the village today, selling pills that looked very sketchy.

column3: 今天悟出：天赋不够，那就多睡一会儿。
column4: Realized today: if talent's lacking, just sleep a bit more.

column3: 练气练到一半，发现自己在想晚饭吃什么。
column4: Halfway through qi cultivation, realized I was thinking about dinner.

column3: 今天看到云朵的形状像一只鸡，瞬间没了修炼的心情。
column4: Saw a cloud shaped like a chicken today. Lost all motivation to cultivate.

column3: 听说有人靠丹药一步登天，我连丹药钱都没有。
column4: Heard someone ascended instantly with pills. I don't even have money for pills.

column3: 今天的灵气似乎特别活跃，可能只是风大。
column4: The qi seemed unusually active today. Might just be the wind.

column3: 村里办喜事，借口去蹭饭，顺便休息一天。
column4: There was a celebration in the village. Used it as an excuse to eat and rest for a day.

column3: 今天试着用古法呼吸，差点把自己呼吸乱了。
column4: Tried an ancient breathing technique today. Nearly threw off my own breathing.

column3: 听老人说修仙先修心，我决定先修个午睡。
column4: The elders say cultivate the heart first. I decided to cultivate a nap first.

column3: 今天发现自己的灵根检测报告丢了，反正也没什么用。
column4: Found my spiritual root test report missing today. Probably wasn't important anyway.

column3: 练功间隙看了会儿蚂蚁搬家，比修炼有意思多了。
column4: Watched ants moving house during a break today. More interesting than cultivating.

column3: 今天想通了一件事：着急也没用，不如先吃个橘子。
column4: Figured something out today: rushing won't help, might as well eat an orange first.

column3: 村里的孩子问我什么时候能飞，我说等我学会走稳了。
column4: A village kid asked when I'll fly. Said I'll learn to walk steadily first.

column3: 今天的修炼计划：先躺十分钟，再决定要不要修炼。
column4: Today's cultivation plan: lie down for ten minutes, then decide whether to cultivate.

column3: 听说邻村有人走火入魔了，我连火都没点着。
column4: Heard someone in the next village went qi-deviant. I haven't even started a fire.

column3: 今天默念口诀三遍，感觉嘴巴比灵气更累。
column4: Recited the mantra three times today. My mouth got more tired than my qi did.

column3: 天气好，决定把修炼挪到明天。
column4: The weather's nice today. Decided to move cultivation to tomorrow.

column3: 今天悟到一个道理：修炼急不来，但晚饭不能等。
column4: Realized today: cultivation can't be rushed, but dinner can't wait either.

column3: 村口新开了个杂货铺，顺便去看了看有没有便宜丹药。
column4: A new general store opened at the village entrance. Checked if they had any cheap pills.

column3: 今天打坐时听到自己肚子叫，灵气没动，肚子先动了。
column4: Heard my own stomach growl while meditating today. The stomach moved before the qi did.

column3: 听说修炼讲究天时地利，我连个闹钟都没设。
column4: Heard cultivation needs the right timing and place. I didn't even set an alarm.

column3: 今天对镜子练习了深邃的表情，结果笑出声了。
column4: Practiced a profound expression in the mirror today. Ended up laughing out loud.

column3: 练功练到一半下雨了，赶紧收衣服去了。
column4: It started raining halfway through training today. Rushed to bring in the laundry.

column3: 今天想，要不要给自己起个修仙界的花名，想了半天没想出来。
column4: Thought about giving myself a cultivation-world nickname today. Couldn't think of one.

column3: 听说灵根分五种，我打算先把饭吃完再研究。
column4: Heard there are five types of spiritual roots. Plan to finish eating first before researching.

column3: 今天看着远山发了会儿呆，感觉自己悟了，又感觉没悟。
column4: Stared at the distant mountains today. Felt enlightened, then felt not enlightened at all.

column3: 练气的时候打了个哈欠，灵气好像也跟着犯困了。
column4: Yawned while cultivating qi today. The qi seemed to get sleepy too.

column3: 今天决定，修炼之前先把房间打扫一下，再决定要不要修炼。
column4: Decided to clean my room before cultivating today, then decide whether to actually cultivate.

column3: 村里的老人说我骨骼惊奇，但具体哪里惊奇没说清楚。
column4: An elder said my bones are extraordinary today, but didn't specify which part.

column3: 今天试着冥想天地大道，结果想到了昨天没吃完的包子。
column4: Tried meditating on the great Dao today. Ended up thinking about yesterday's leftover bun.

column3: 听说修仙第一步是看淡名利，我先看淡了起床这件事。
column4: Heard the first step of cultivation is letting go of fame and wealth. I let go of getting up first.

column3: 今天扎马步扎到腿抖，但坚持了五分钟。
column4: Held the horse stance until my legs shook today. Lasted five whole minutes.

column3: 同门今天炫耀他的拳法，我默默把袖子拉低了一点。
column4: A fellow disciple showed off his fist technique today. Quietly pulled my sleeve lower.

column3: 今天练拳打偏了，差点打到自己的鼻子。
column4: Missed my target while practicing today, nearly hit my own nose.

column3: 练功房今天人很多，感觉大家都比我厉害。
column4: The training hall was crowded today. Felt like everyone was stronger than me.

column3: 今天的体术训练让我浑身酸痛，但莫名有点爽。
column4: Today's body training left me sore all over, but oddly satisfying.

column3: 听说隔壁峰的师兄已经武者中期了，我才刚摸到门道。
column4: Heard the senior from the next peak is already mid Martial. I'm just getting started.

column3: 今天打沙袋时想象沙袋是昨天偷吃我灵石的人。
column4: Imagined the punching bag was the guy who stole my spirit stones yesterday.

column3: 练功练到一半肌肉抽筋，疼得我直接坐地上。
column4: My muscles cramped halfway through training today. Sat right down from the pain.

column3: 今天悟出一招新拳法，结果忘了怎么收尾。
column4: Figured out a new fist technique today, then forgot how to finish the move.

column3: 同门说我进步神速，我怀疑他在安慰我。
column4: A fellow disciple said I'm improving fast. Suspect he was just being nice.

column3: 今天练剑差点把自己的手指削掉，吓出一身冷汗。
column4: Nearly sliced my own finger off practicing swordplay today. Broke into a cold sweat.

column3: 体力训练后躺在地上看天，感觉天比我累。
column4: Lay on the ground after physical training today, staring at the sky. Felt like the sky was more tired than me.

column3: 今天和同门切磋，三招就被打倒，但学到了三招。
column4: Sparred with a fellow disciple today. Lost in three moves, but learned three moves.

column3: 听说要练成铁布衫得挨打三年，我决定先挨一天看看。
column4: Heard mastering the Iron Shirt takes three years of beatings. Decided to try one day first.

column3: 今天扛着石头爬山练体力，扛到一半想扔了石头自己跑。
column4: Carried a rock up the mountain for endurance training today. Wanted to drop it and run halfway up.

column3: 练拳房的镜子今天被我打裂了一道缝，师兄说这也算进步。
column4: Cracked the training hall mirror with a punch today. A senior said that counts as progress.

column3: 今天练气血运转，结果打了个嗝，气血没运转，嗝先出来了。
column4: Tried circulating blood and qi today. A burp came out before the qi did.

column3: 听说武者要经历筋骨重塑，我现在只感觉到骨头疼。
column4: Heard Martial Artists undergo bone restructuring. Right now I just feel my bones aching.

column3: 今天和师兄比拼力气，输了，但至少没把手举不起来。
column4: Had a strength contest with a senior today. Lost, but at least I can still lift my arms.

column3: 练功间隙看同门吃饭，比看他们练功还认真。
column4: Watched fellow disciples eat during a break today. Watched more intently than I watch them train.

column3: 今天悟出：武道之路，三分靠练，七分靠装。
column4: Realized today: the martial path is thirty percent training, seventy percent looking the part.

column3: 练拳打到出汗，汗滴进眼睛里，疼得我中断了训练。
column4: Sweated through training today. Sweat got in my eyes, had to stop.

column3: 今天打坐运气，感觉气血在体内绕了三圈又回去睡觉了。
column4: Meditated on qi circulation today. Felt the qi loop three times then go back to sleep.

column3: 听说武道高手能一拳碎石，我现在的拳头只能碎自信。
column4: Heard master Martial Artists can shatter stone with one punch. Mine can only shatter my confidence.

column3: 今天练体术悟出一个道理：摔得多了就不疼了，是骗人的。
column4: Realized something during body training today: the saying that enough falls stop hurting is a lie.

column3: 同门今天打趣我练拳像跳舞，我假装没听见。
column4: A fellow disciple joked my fist technique looks like dancing today. Pretended not to hear.

column3: 今天的力量训练让手臂抬不起来，连吃饭都得用意念。
column4: Today's strength training left my arms unable to lift. Had to eat with sheer willpower.

column3: 练功房今天换了新的木桩，我打了一拳，木桩没事，我手疼。
column4: New training dummy in the hall today. Punched it once. Dummy's fine, my hand hurts.

column3: 听说真气贯通全身需要悟性，我决定先贯通晚饭。
column4: Heard circulating true qi requires insight. Decided to circulate dinner first.

column3: 今天练完拳，感觉自己离武林高手又近了一毫米。
column4: Finished training today. Felt one millimeter closer to becoming a martial master.

column3: 练气血时打了个寒颤，气血没循环，鸡皮疙瘩先起来了。
column4: Shivered while circulating qi and blood today. Goosebumps arrived before the circulation did.

column3: 今天悟出新招，转头就忘了怎么用，只记得很帅。
column4: Came up with a new move today. Forgot how to use it immediately, only remember it looked cool.

column3: 体能训练后腿软到连走路都得扶墙。
column4: My legs were so weak after endurance training I had to lean on the wall to walk.

column3: 同门今天说我气势变强了，我以为他在说我饭量。
column4: A fellow disciple said my presence feels stronger today. Thought he meant my appetite.

column3: 今天练拳时被自己的影子吓了一下，瞬间觉得有点丢脸。
column4: Got startled by my own shadow while training today. Felt a bit embarrassed.

column3: 听说武道讲究意随心动，我现在意随饭动。
column4: Heard the martial path follows the heart's intent. Mine follows my stomach's intent.

column3: 今天扎马步的时候蚊子咬了我一口，纠结要不要破功去打它。
column4: A mosquito bit me during horse stance training today. Debated whether breaking form to swat it was worth it.

column3: 练功练到出神，回过神来发现已经过去半个时辰想着晚饭。
column4: Zoned out during training today. Snapped back to realize half an hour passed thinking about dinner.

column3: 今天悟出真气如水，结果一不小心呛了口水。
column4: Realized true qi flows like water today. Promptly choked on actual water.

column3: 听说武者要懂得借力打力，我只懂得借口不练。
column4: Heard Martial Artists must master using force against force. I've only mastered using excuses against training.

column3: 今天练拳手感不错，可能是因为偷懒休息了一天。
column4: My form felt good during training today. Possibly because I slacked off and rested yesterday.

column3: 体术训练让我学会了一招：闭眼硬挨。
column4: Body training taught me one move today: close your eyes and take the hit.

column3: 今天和同门一起练功，比谁先喊累，我赢了。
column4: Trained with fellow disciples today, competing to see who'd complain of exhaustion first. I won.

column3: 听说武道极致是人剑合一，我现在是人床合一。
column4: Heard the pinnacle of the martial path is becoming one with the sword. I've become one with my bed.

column3: 今天打沙袋打出了感觉，沙袋打出了破洞。
